The legal right to work in GCC without company sponsorship or time restriction.
Experience in handling laboratory analytical and data acquisition equipment
Good presentation and communication skills in Arabic
Eagerness to learn new technology, software tools & other relevant domains
Awareness of different type of sensors, working principles, usage scenarios.
